aboutGame.title: What is Apocalypse Rising 2?
paragraphs: Apocalypse Rising 2 is an open-world zombie survival shooter on Roblox from Dualpoint Interactive. You spawn on the coast of a large archipelago with almost nothing, then loot towns, military bases and crash sites for weapons, ammo, food, medical supplies and vehicle parts while the Infected and other players hunt you across the map.

There is no level cap and no class system to grind through. Progression is entirely gear-driven: a better rifle, a larger backpack, a working car and a stocked medkit are what keep a run alive. Our Apocalypse Rising 2 wiki covers every system, from loot tier lists and gun rankings to base building, vehicles and the random events that hand out the rarest loot on the map.

modules.name: Apocalypse Rising 2 Beginner Guide
modules.description: A first-run walkthrough for fresh spawns: survival bars, the ten-minute checklist, loot tiering and how to win early fights against the Infected.

highlights.detail: Scout the horizon from high ground, lighthouses and hills for smoke trails, player silhouettes and boat spawns
Secure a melee weapon from barns, tool sheds and garages before you make any noise
Upgrade your backpack in residential homes and small camps so you can carry more loot
Pick up a basic firearm from police cruisers and residential closets for emergency ranged defense
Stock bandages, gauze and health tonics from bathrooms, clinics and ambulances

modules.name: Apocalypse Rising 2 Weapons Guide
modules.description: Firearms, melee weapons and attachments compared by time-to-kill, recoil, ammo availability and attachment support.

highlights.label: Rifles
highlights.detail: The M4A1, AK-47 and FAL rule mid-range fights when you can feed them 5.56mm or 7.62mm ammo

highlights.label: SMGs
highlights.detail: The MP5 and MP5K deliver near-zero horizontal recoil for clearing buildings fast

highlights.label: Shotguns
highlights.detail: SPAS-12 and 12-gauge pumps win indoor point defense against armored players

highlights.label: Snipers
highlights.detail: The L96A1 and Mini-14 punish anyone crossing open runways and fields

highlights.label: Melee
highlights.detail: Crowbars, fire axes and combat knives clear the Infected without giving away your position

highlights.label: Muzzle
highlights.detail: Suppressors, compensators and muzzle brakes are the cheapest recoil and stealth upgrade

modules.name: Apocalypse Rising 2 Map Guide
modules.description: The archipelago broken down by region, loot tier, risk level and the transit corridors that connect them.

highlights.label: Ashland
highlights.detail: Ashland Commercial Center spawns special forces gear and 7.62 rifles, and draws the heaviest PvP

highlights.label: Airport
highlights.detail: Regional Airport holds aviation gear and high-tier backpacks along wide open runways

highlights.label: Naval Base
highlights.detail: Naval Air Station is the crown jewel for heavy armor, snipers and military crates

highlights.label: Mackinaw
highlights.detail: Mackinaw Fort offers mid-tier military and utility spawns at a calmer contest level

highlights.label: Beaufort
highlights.detail: Beaufort townships are reliable for food, civilian ammo and backpack upgrades

highlights.label: Docks
highlights.detail: Coastal docks provide boat spawns, repair kits and fuel for island rotations

modules.name: Apocalypse Rising 2 Loot Guide
modules.description: Loot locations ranked from S to C by gear tier, crate density and how often other players contest them.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Naval Air Station, Regional Airport and Fort Halsey - high-end military gear, 5.56 and 7.62 ammo, snipers

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Beaufort, Ashland and Mackinaw Military Encampment - assault rifles, shotguns, police gear and medical supplies

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Coastal docks, logging camp and fairgrounds - industrial loot, hunting rifles and light consumables

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Scattered farmsteads, coastal cabins and gas stations - basic pistols, civilian clothes and canned food

modules.name: Apocalypse Rising 2 Vehicles Guide
modules.description: Every vehicle class compared by passenger capacity, armor, off-road handling and the parts needed to keep it running.

highlights.label: Sedans
highlights.detail: Fast scout runs for 2 to 4 players, but fragile frames and exposed passenger hitboxes

highlights.label: Pickups
highlights.detail: Pickups and utility vehicles balance moderate armor with good off-road travel

highlights.label: Trucks
highlights.detail: Heavy trucks and vans carry 4 to 6+ players and soak repeated rifle fire

highlights.label: Military
highlights.detail: Military transports offer very high armor and the best off-road handling in the game

highlights.label: Boats
highlights.detail: Watercraft and jetskis move 1 to 4 players between islands without swimming

highlights.label: Repairs
highlights.detail: Carry vehicle toolkits, jerry cans and spare parts or your ride stays where you found it

highlights.label: Uncommon

highlights.detail: Woodland BDU, desert camo and pilot flight suits drop at airfields and radar sites

highlights.detail: Special ops blackout, smuggler attire and ghillie pieces come from naval bases and elite Infected

highlights.label: Event

highlights.label: Routes

modules.name: Apocalypse Rising 2 Codes
modules.description: The verified status of redeemable rewards, how a future redemption system would work and how to avoid scam pages.

highlights.label: NONE ACTIVE
highlights.detail: No redeemable promo codes are currently issued for Apocalypse Rising 2

highlights.label: NO CONSOLE
highlights.detail: The game ships with no promo code box in its settings or inventory menus

highlights.label: VANITY ONLY

items.question: What is Apocalypse Rising 2?
items.answer: Apocalypse Rising 2 is a free open-world zombie survival shooter on Roblox from Dualpoint Interactive. You loot an archipelago for weapons, food and medical supplies, fight off the Infected and other players, and keep whatever you can carry out.

items.question: Does Apocalypse Rising 2 have working codes?
items.answer: No. Apocalypse Rising 2 currently has no active promo codes and the game ships with no code redemption box. Any site promising free military gear for a code is running clickbait or a phishing scam.

items.question: Where is the best loot in Apocalypse Rising 2?
items.answer: Naval Air Station, Regional Airport and Fort Halsey spawn the highest-tier military weapons and armor in Apocalypse Rising 2, but they are also the most contested. Beaufort, Ashland and Mackinaw are calmer mid-tier alternatives.

items.question: What are the best weapons in Apocalypse Rising 2?
items.answer: The FAL, M14 EBR and L96A1 top most Apocalypse Rising 2 tier lists for range, while the Patriot, MP5K and Ots-14 Groza dominate close quarters. All of them depend on scarce 7.62mm and 5.56mm ammunition.

items.question: How do you get vehicles in Apocalypse Rising 2?
items.answer: Cars and boats spawn across the Apocalypse Rising 2 archipelago. Most need fuel, a vehicle toolkit and spare parts before they will run, so carry a jerry can and a repair kit on every long rotation.
